name: Turn Emails into AI-Enhanced Tasks in Notion (Multi-User Support) with Gmail, Airtable and Softr
description: Transforms emails into AI-enhanced tasks in Notion, supporting multiple users. It integrates with Gmail for email triggers, Airtable for routing, and Softr for a user interface.

nodes.label: Params: Send notification about missing route

inputs.system:
Your task is to understand the Email content and extract one actionable task. If there is no obvious actionable task, then just create a title which implies to take a look at this Email by addressing the content summarized to 5 words. The title should be quite decided. This attribute is called title.

Create a proper description for the task. Be precise but detailed. Start with a short sentence and if it is worth adding more information, add bulletpoints after that containing additional information which help to understand the context of the task better, like links and other references, or just more detailed instructions. Add the description to the output as attribute output. Add the bulletpoints to the output as attribute output, but remember, bullet points are optional.

Return all attributes in a JSON format.

Summarize the email (as much detail as possible) and add it to the output as the attribute summary.

Extract the email sender, subject and date of receipt. If this is a forwarded email, then get this data from the original message, otherwise use the meta data of this Email. Format the Email Adress as follows, and add it to the JSON output as the attribute meta.sender: "From: Full Name <mail@example.com". Format the the subject as follows and add it to the output as attribute meta.subject: "Subject: SubjectGoesHere". Format the the date as follows and add it to the output as attribute meta.date: "Date: DateStringGoesHere" (Date format: RFC 2822).

Return all attributes in a JSON format.

blockers.detail: webhook trigger googlesuper/GOOGLESUPER_NEW_MESSAGE needs webhookEndpointId, connectedAccountId

setup: "Gmail Trigger": after import, register the googlesuper webhook (`cdecli webhook endpoint create -c googlesuper`, then `cdecli trigger instance upsert --slug GOOGLESUPER_NEW_MESSAGE`) and set webhookEndpointId, connectedAccountId on the trigger node.
Setup value airtableBaseId: Airtable base id (for example appXXXX (from the base URL)). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Setup value airtableTableId: Airtable table id (for example tblXXXX (from the table URL)). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.

hints: "Gmail Trigger" is a provider webhook (googlesuper/GOOGLESUPER_NEW_MESSAGE). Create the endpoint and trigger instance, then paste the we_… id and connected account into this node before the first run: `cdecli webhook endpoint create -c googlesuper --client-id <id>`, `cdecli webhook endpoint set-data <we_id> --signing-secret <secret>`, `cdecli trigger instance upsert --slug GOOGLESUPER_NEW_MESSAGE --account <connectedAccountId>`.
"Generate Actionable Task" used agent tools in the original: Calculator1 (toolCalculator). The cdecli agent calls connectors directly; connect credentials for the services those tools reached.
"Get Summary & Meta Data" used agent tools in the original: Calculator (toolCalculator). The cdecli agent calls connectors directly; connect credentials for the services those tools reached.
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect airtable: `cdecli credential create -n "airtable" -p airtable --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
Connect googlesuper: `cdecli credential create -n "googlesuper" -p googlesuper --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).

notes:
## Setup
- Disable the Gmail Trigger and enable the manual trigger here
- Execute the workflow once
- Copy the Gmail Label IDs from the output of the "Required labels" node to the "Globals" node
- Disable the manual trigger here and and enable the Gmail Trigger again
- Activate the workflow, so it runs automatically in the background

## Set Globals
Use the setup instructions below to retrieve the values for both `errorLabelID` and `processedLabelID`

## Select Base
Select the database and the table where the "Routes" are defined
The Gmail inbox is checked every minute for new entries
Extract the Airtable Row ID from the Email address
Filter by labels to prohibit double-processing
Dynamically build request body for Notion, since dynamic auth, and content with optional fields require a custom request
The custom built request including the user specific authentication is sent to Notion to create a new Page inside of a database

The Email is processed in multiple ways:
- An actionable task is being generated based on the content, consisting of a short title, a short description and optionally a few details as bullet points
- A detailed Email summary is being generated
- Meta data is being extracted - so the user has a reference to find the original Email again
- To get more stable results, the tasks are devided between two Agents
Skip disabled routes (determined by a checkbox attribute in Airtable)
Send custom Email notifications back to sender, containing an error message and suggestions to fix it
Add labels which prevent from double-processing
Disable a checkbox attribute in Airtable which determines if a route is active
